title: 924. Reorder Data in Log Files

examples.input: logs = ["dig1 8 1 5 1","let1 art can","dig2 3 6","let2 own kit dig","let3 art zero"]
examples.output: ["let1 art can","let3 art zero","let2 own kit dig","dig1 8 1 5 1","dig2 3 6"]
examples.explanation: Letter-logs sort by content; digits stay behind in order.

examples.input: logs = ["a1 9 2 3 1","g1 act car","zo4 4 7","ab1 off key dog","a8 act zoo"]
examples.output: ["g1 act car","a8 act zoo","ab1 off key dog","a1 9 2 3 1","zo4 4 7"]

examples.explanation: With only digits, the order is unchanged.

hints: A log is a digit-log when the first character after the identifier is a digit; otherwise it is a letter-log.
Sort letter-logs by the tuple (content, identifier); keep digit-logs in input order.
Concatenate sorted letters followed by the untouched digits.
